title: NSClient - translation issues
symptom: In 3.0.0.1 NSclient, although the language is set to English in Preferences>General>Language, some parts of the UI (hamburger menu, home screen, local profile screen, three dot menu) are still translated to the default system language (Polish in this case). Additionally, when the default system language differs from the language set in preferences, an extra option for NSclient preferences -> synchronisation appears, but when they match, that option is missing.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify a root cause, but it is implied that the issue is related to translation handling in the app, possibly due to incorrect translations or a bug in the language selection logic.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/8653c0f0d64a0f91d27e480a998c617b8dcaea0b
